PATIENT PREPARATION PROTOCOL

Laboratory & Phlebotomy Guide

Important instructions to ensure peak clinical accuracy for your diagnostic blood, urine, and metabolic tests.

🥗 Fasting Instructions

  • 10 - 12 Hours Fasting: Required for Lipid Profile, Fasting Blood Sugar, and Full Body Checkups.
  • Water is Allowed: You may drink plain water in normal amounts to remain hydrated.
  • Avoid Coffee & Tea: Caffeinated drinks and milk products can alter glucose and enzyme parameters.
  • No Alcohol: Avoid alcohol intake for 24 hours prior to liver and lipid assessments.

🧪 Urine & Stool Sample Protocol

  • Clean-Catch Midstream Urine: Discard the initial stream of urine and collect the midstream portion.
  • Sterile Containers: Only use sterile containers provided by HealthLab phlebotomists.
  • Morning Specimen: First-morning urine is preferred for routine analysis and pregnancy tests.
  • Timely Delivery: Submit collected sample to the lab within 2 hours or keep chilled.

🏠 Home Sample Collection Preparation

  • Phlebotomist Arrival: Our certified technician will arrive within your chosen 1-hour slot.
  • Safety Seals: Technicians open fresh disposable vacutainer needles in front of you.
  • SMS Tracking: You will receive technician name and temperature reading via SMS.

📱 Digital Report Access

  • Instant Notification: An SMS and WhatsApp notification is sent when your report is signed.
  • Patient Portal: Use your booking reference (e.g. HL-2026-001) to track test parameters anytime.
  • Physical Copy: Free printed copy available at our Green Park diagnostic desk.
